subject.title: fix(config): warn when JSON5 comments are lost on config write

question: Should JSON5 comment-loss diagnostics become a permanent field on the exported plugin SDK config-write and mutation results?
rationale: The bug fix needs a structured quiet-mode signal, but the selected transport changes a documented external plugin contract and repository policy reserves that API direction for explicit owner approval.

options.title: Approve and document the result field
options.body: Keep the additive structured warning, document its semantics on the config-mutation SDK surface, add focused surface coverage, and require current-head public-path proof.

options.title: Keep the diagnostic internal
options.body: Remove the exported result fields and route the warning through an existing internal caller-owned diagnostic or presentation seam instead.

recommendation.title: Approve and document the result field
recommendation.body: Keep the additive structured warning, document its semantics on the config-mutation SDK surface, add focused surface coverage, and require current-head public-path proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent config hardening and plugin SDK contract work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the API decision.
